description: Use this when the user asks what Horseback offers or looks for horse riding, hippotherapy, field games, city detox, self-defense or shooting classes at Horseback near Zawiercie. Do not use for events on specific dates (use get_upcoming_events) or for places other than Horseback. Returns categories with descriptions and the classes in each one (id, name, format, description, date if the class has one, link), the same as the /zajecia pages. Optionally filter by category id. For the full page of one class call get_activity_details with its id. noUpcomingDate means the event currently has no date - say so and suggest asking about the next one.

category.description: Optional category id; omit to get all categories.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

name: get_activities

noUpcomingDate.description: Present when the event has no future date (only past ones): tell the user there is currently no date and to ask Horseback about the next one.

contact.description: Horseback contact: phone, email, website, social profiles.

title: Zajęcia i usługi
